activity_summary: During the afternoon play, late snow came into the Cross Keys yard and thinned it. Standers drew under the gallery. A candle was lit early in the parlour. You were in the play. You did not count the house from the curtain.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played, and did not count the thinned yard.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Is at the rail in the king's mantle, and is only seen.

facets.activity: Played while the snow thinned the yard
